method: manual measurements during initial repo build, collected live on 2026-08-18; from the next snapshot on, data is collected by scripts/patent_search.py `snapshot` (weekly workflow or manual runs)
caveats: counts are patent publications, not granted patents or deduplicated families
assignee leaderboard facets are sampled by the source; treat as relative shares
filings from the last ~18 months are undercounted due to publication lag
